title: His brothers who played music
summary: He describes his brothers William, Lucien and a younger drummer brother who played with Billie and De De.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Could you tell us some more about your other brothers that played music?

I have another brother. Well, he's learning trumpet. William Barber. He played around with several organized groups and... But he never did keep it up. Lucien Barber and my other brother, which passed, he played with the D and... Billy?
Can you remember any more about him? Did he take any lessons? No, he never did take any lessons.
He'd been a good drummer, too. Was he younger than you? Yeah, he was younger than me.
Well, two years different. Oh, two years. Two years different.
Well, did he play with anybody else, you say, besides... Did he? Well, I know. Did he start on your drum?
